fields: *Maybe you can hear the bunny coming in, or something. A window opening*
She comes closer to the bed as Red stirs.
Red begins to wake, he sits up on the bed.
[pic=6]You’ve been out for quite a while, dear.
[pic=3]Please take it easy and relax all you need.
[pic=2]Why, you’ve found yourself in our quaint little town.
[pic=3]The parts here are called The Forest of Love.
Oh perfect! Exactly where I want to be!
[pic=3]Oh? You were searching for this place?
[pic=3]We’re a bit off the beaten path, but you’re here now!
[pic=2]You’ve even got a few get-well gifts and flowers waiting for ya on the table!
[pic=3]We don’t often get visitors, especially the uh… passin’ out kind…
[pic=2]But we do our best to do right by our travelers!
[pic=6]Actually I was hoping you’d fill us in there!
[pic=6]Last night as the sun was setting, our resident hawk was doing her patrol - and saw you collapsed!

I uh… maybe haven’t slept
for a day… or 2…
[pic=4]Come now, you couldn’t have just taken a nap under a tree or something? Sheesh!
[pic=4]You had us worried sick! Kids these days, I swear.
[pic=7]Ahh nothing to be sorry about dear. I’m just glad you’re OK.
[pic=2]There’s some food and water I’ve prepared just a bit ago. Please help yourself to them!
[pic=3]I’ll let the others know you’re doing OK, and you can come on out whenever you’re ready.
*Quick fade to black* (bunny needs to leave)
I think I’ve been here before…
